tagline: Bade addresses, aur hosts jo khud ko set up kar lete hain.
description: IPv6 128-bit addresses use karta hai, isliye har device ko public address mil sakta hai. Naye host ko DHCP server ki zaroorat nahi: woh router ka advertisement sunta hai, network prefix se apna address khud banata hai (SLAAC), check karta hai ki kisi aur ke paas toh nahi, aur neighbours ke MAC addresses ARP ki jagah ICMPv6 se dhoondhta hai.

slaac.name: Plug in karo, address lo, ping karo
slaac.summary: Laptop network se judta hai, apna IPv6 address khud banata hai, use check karta hai, router ka MAC dhoondhta hai aur ek server ko ping karta hai.

steps.title: Yahan koi router hai?
steps.detail: Laptop ne apne MAC se pehle hi ek link-local address, fe80::3e22:fbff:fe7a:910e, bana liya hai. Woh sirf isi cable par kaam karta hai. Router dhoondhne ke liye woh ff02::2, all-routers group, ko Router Solicitation bhejta hai. Ethernet par yeh group MAC 33:33:00:00:00:02 se map hota hai: 33:33 ke baad IPv6 address ke last 32 bits.

quiz.q: All-nodes group ff02::1 hai. Ethernet par yeh kaunsa MAC address use karta hai?
options: ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
quiz.why: IPv6 multicast 33:33 plus group address ke last four bytes se map hota hai. IPv6 mein broadcast hota hi nahi.

steps.title: Router Advertisement
steps.detail: Router sabko (ff02::1) Router Advertisement se jawab deta hai. Woh kehta hai: main 30 minutes ke liye default gateway hoon, network prefix 2001:db8:1::/64 hai, MTU 1500 hai, aur yeh raha ek DNS server. Prefix par A flag ka matlab hai ki hosts isse apna address khud bana sakte hain.

quiz.q: Prefix pehle 64 bits deta hai. Laptop ke address ke last 64 bits kahan se aate hain?
options: Router assign karta hai
Laptop khud banata hai
DHCP server
DNS server
quiz.why: SLAAC ka yahi point hai: host apna interface ID khud banata hai, yahan apne MAC se (EUI-64). Modern systems aksar privacy ke liye random wala use karte hain.

steps.title: Kya yeh le liya gaya hai? (DAD)
steps.detail: Laptop 2001:db8:1::3e22:fbff:fe7a:910e banata hai lekin ise “tentative” rakhta hai. Woh poochta hai ki koi pehle se ise use kar raha hai kya, unspecified address :: se address ke solicited-node group ff02::1:ff7a:910e ko Neighbor Solicitation bhejkar. Wahan sirf woh devices sunte hain jinka address 7a:91:0e par khatam hota hai.

quiz.q: Laptop DAD apne naye address ki jagah :: se kyun bhejta hai?
options: Bytes bachane ke liye
Jab tak pata na chale ki kisi aur ke paas nahi hai, woh address use nahi kar sakta
Routers dusre sources ignore karte hain
Address bahut lamba hai
quiz.why: Tentative address ko source ke roop mein use nahi karna chahiye. Agar koi aur host uska maalik hota, to replies galat jagah jate.

steps.title: Khamoshi matlab haan
steps.desc: Ek second mein koi jawab nahi: address hamara hai
steps.detail: Ek second ke andar koi jawab nahi deta, isliye address unique hai. Laptop ke paas ab ek global address hai jo usne khud banaya, aur advertisement se mila default gateway (fe80::1). Kisi server ne kuch diya nahi.

steps.title: Router ka MAC dhoondo
steps.detail: Network ke bahar kuch bhejne ke liye laptop ko fe80::1 ka MAC chahiye. Kai routers use RA mein daal dete hain; yeh wala nahi daala, isliye laptop poochta hai. Woh router ke solicited-node group ko Neighbor Solicitation bhejta hai, aur router seedha Neighbor Advertisement se jawab deta hai jisme uska MAC hota hai. Yeh IPv6 ka ARP wala version hai.

quiz.q: IPv4 ke ARP se yeh kaise alag hai?
options: Yeh sabko broadcast use karta hai
Yeh aise multicast group use karta hai jise sirf target sunta hai
Ise DHCP server chahiye
Bilkul alag nahi hai
quiz.why: ARP requests har device ko jati hain. NS solicited-node group ko jata hai, isliye lagbhag sirf target ke network card ko ise dekhna padta hai.

steps.title: Server ko ping6
steps.desc: IPv6 par echo request aur reply
steps.detail: Ab laptop internet tak pahunch sakta hai. Woh apne naye global address se 2001:db8:ab::10 ko ICMPv6 Echo Request (type 128) se ping karta hai, router ke MAC ke frame mein. Server Echo Reply (type 129) se jawab deta hai. Kahin NAT nahi: server ko laptop ka asli address dikhta hai.

outro.title: Bina server ke set up
outro.text: Laptop ne routers ke baare mein poocha, advertisement se prefix seekha, apna address banaya, check kiya ki woh unique hai aur router ka MAC dhoondha, sab ICMPv6 se. Phir usne ek asli, public address ke saath ek server ko ping kiya, bina NAT ke.

dad-fail.name: Duplicate address pakda gaya
dad-fail.summary: Kisi ne ek static address type kar diya jo NAS pehle se use karta hai. DAD kuch bigadne se pehle ise pakad leta hai.

steps.title: Haath se type kiya address
steps.detail: Koi laptop ka address haath se 2001:db8:1::10 set karta hai. Static addresses bhi DAD se guzarte hain. Laptop :: se ff02::1:ff00:10 ko Neighbor Solicitation bhejta hai, jo 00:00:10 par khatam hone wale addresses ka group hai.

steps.title: NAS aitraaz karta hai
steps.detail: NAS pehle se 2001:db8:1::10 use kar raha hai, isliye woh Neighbor Advertisement se jawab deta hai. Poochne wale ke paas abhi address nahi, isliye NAS use seedha reply nahi kar sakta. Woh ff02::1, all nodes, ko bhejta hai, aur laptop sun leta hai.
facts: ff02::1 (asker ke paas address nahi tha)

quiz.q: NAS apna jawab laptop ki jagah ff02::1 ko kyun bhejta hai?
options: Use laptop ka MAC nahi pata
Sawaal :: se aaya tha, isliye reply karne ke liye koi address nahi hai
Saare NAs ff02::1 ko jate hain
Router ko warn karne ke liye
quiz.why: DAD probe unspecified address :: se aaya tha. Poochne wale tak pahunchne ka ek hi tareeka hai: all-nodes group.

steps.title: Address refuse hua
steps.desc: Duplicate mark hua, kabhi use nahi hua
steps.detail: Laptop 2001:db8:1::10 ko duplicate mark karta hai aur uss se kabhi nahi bhejta, isliye NAS chalta rehta hai. Linux log karta hai “IPv6 duplicate address 2001:db8:1::10 used by 00:11:32:c4:5e:07 detected!”. Fix hai doosra static address chunna ya SLAAC ko chunne dena.

quiz.q: IPv4 mein agar do hosts ka same address ho aur koi check na chale to kya hoga?
options: Kuch nahi, theek chalta hai
Dono ARP par ladte aur traffic galat wale ke paas jata
Router ek ko renumber kar deta
Switch ek ko block kar deta
quiz.why: Check ke bina dono hosts ARP ka jawab dete hain aur doosre devices unke beech badalte rehte hain. DAD address use hone se pehle hi yeh rok deta hai.

outro.title: Nuksan se pehle pakda gaya
outro.text: Duplicate Address Detection har naye IPv6 address ko, haath se type kiye hue ko bhi, use hone se pehle check karta hai. :: se ek NS aur wapas ek NA kaafi the taaki laptop NAS ka address na chura sake.

cheatsheet.title: Yaad rakhne wale addresses
items: Link-local, har interface ke paas hota hai
